issue_description: The purifier stopped dispensing water four days after installation and showed a filter error despite being new. The customer called the helpline twice on 24 and 25 February.
resolution_provided: A replacement unit was shipped on 08 March and installed by an engineer on 12 March. The faulty unit was collected at the same visit. The customer confirmed the replacement is working correctly.

issue_description: The washing machine has leaked from the base since it was installed on 29 January. The customer has called the helpline multiple times, and an engineer was promised to visit within 48 hours, but no one has come after eleven days.

The customer is inquiring about the Model X400 water purifier, specifically about the filter cartridge replacement frequency, whether professional installation is included in the price, and the warranty coverage for the first year.

The customer reported that the filter replacement indicator on their air purifier remains red even after installing a new filter, and the reset button is unresponsive. They have attempted to unplug the unit overnight as suggested in the manual.

The air purifier arrived with a cracked front panel. The unit powers on and appears to function, but the damage is visible from the front of the room and the customer does not want to keep it in this state.
resolution_provided: A replacement front panel has been ordered from the supplier. The customer was told it would arrive within two weeks and that an engineer would fit it. The part has not yet arrived.
